set.statement: rhiza request <text> [--kind feature|bug|milestone] queues a plan request in the clone's .git/rhiza/requests.json, rhiza request ls shows each request's state, and the daemon, when not paused and a slot is free, starts a plan run for the oldest queued feature or bug request, autonomous when rhiza.autonomy.plan is auto, marking the request with its run and later the change set it planned; a queued milestone request instead starts at the next poll, first and without a free slot (milestone-request-starts-at-once), and its plan run always waits on the owner, never autonomous
